title: Quantum Circuit Kernels for High-Order Connectome Graph Classification
summaryPoints: Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQC) encode high-order non-pairwise neural graph interactions into quantum state vectors.
Bypasses exponential feature map explosion of classical graph kernels.
Benchmarked on resting-state connectome datasets for high-precision diagnostic clustering.
significance: Positions quantum machine learning as a viable breakthrough avenue for ultra-high-dimensional biological networks.
labRelevance: Core focus of Connectome Lab's 2025-2026 Quantum Machine Learning Research Internship program.
